description: Reviewed Aitos Act 2 cave walls, ledges, lava, distant formations and open/closed gates. Every native lava phase is included. Runtime identity is native displayed art, palette slots, collision and priority; source IDs and phases are review provenance only.
native_surface_contract: Exact natural brown cavern strata only. Generated exposed faces continue inward from their original native boundary pixel, retaining the source vein and its direction. Body-only dark interior may terminate the native profile. No head crown, lava, door ornament, foreign donor, native collision, depth, silhouette or actor-priority changes. Authored/unknown sources retain the established fallback.
head_crown_surface_contract: Exact native carved-head crown, top only. Follow each actual top edge inward in its owning16px crown cell, stopping at native alpha or the crown cell end before separate eyes/fire. Resample the real prefix once, first/last ink retained. No foreign rock, native front, side, geometry, collision, priority or animation change; edited/unknown sources retain established fallback.
lava_cap_surface_contract: The two floating lava-stone cap artworks spread only their native upper stone prefix (canonical rows 0 through 6) inward from the actual exposed contour. Their lower orange glow stays on the native front; existing textured tops and the dark center stone remain unchanged. Reviewed cap perimeter undersides read their own shaded native pixels inward without bright replacement donors.
